gate_decision_consistency_chk.name: gate_decision_consistency_chk
gate_decision_consistency_chk.value: ("gate"."decision" = 'pending' AND "gate"."decided_at" IS NULL) OR ("gate"."decision" <> 'pending' AND "gate"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

task_actual_order_chk.name: task_actual_order_chk
task_actual_order_chk.value: "task"."actual_end" IS NULL OR "task"."actual_start" IS NULL OR "task"."actual_end" >= "task"."actual_start"
